scope: Typed public task-business adapters retain original transport ceilings at admission, staged commit, cached replay and final delivery after the actual Hub reply/body await. Human CLI canonical readers retain exact binding authority and captured project subsets through their final selection. Local-agent result submission is excluded.

notification_runtime.counting: Setup and repeated dispatch/redaction labels are not independent acceptance cases

clean_commands.counting: Stage totals count invocations, not unique cases; dependencies, notification runtime, X03 and full verification are separate

slice_suites.native_counting: Six distinct collecting groups; domain FIFO, cache lookup and actual Worker/DO response-body cuts are separate witnesses

old_source_probe.status: Frozen initial tests ran on committed unfixed source and its separately built runtime without copying the fixed public-business framework. Thirty-two meaningful authority/body/commit failures and six healthy controls are retained. Expanded focused and native suites prove fixed source only; this is not old-source clean package acceptance.

regression_proof: Original browser/CLI/OAuth human, epoch, role, project and credential restrictions are retained, never enlarged by later role or grant additions
Typed command-owned admission, staged commit, cache and post-Hub selection distinguish no-effect denial, atomic rollback and withheld committed replies
Every staged authority guard attempts exactly one CHECK row even on a missing target; materialized typed selection keeps native D1 within expression depth and parameter bounds
Historical task, context, attention, result and timer replies preserve their original fields and exact lineage without rerunning fresh transition/latest/version guards
Recognized result evidence is checked together; artifact publication binds exact version/grant/run/task and immutable receipt/object metadata; independent timer/parent masks remain safe
Original absent view-grant authorizer, observation clock and one-use artifact replay rejection remain unchanged; execution-owned local-agent result submission bypasses the public factory completely
CLI final project/task/run/attention/artifact/session reads repeat exact current binding, safe scopes, SQL-clock expiry and captured project intersection even for empty and terminal pages
Internal authority is stripped before original command validation, business logic, fingerprint, cursor and audit; metadata receipts and stored results contain no authority capsule
Native full-effect snapshots remain equal after independent production revocation for rollback/read/cache denial; actual post-Hub denial preserves already committed business and idempotency history
proof_boundaries: Mounted browser/CLI route tests and native-D1 witnesses are separate; native retained OAuth metadata is synthetic, not real OAuth/cookie/CLI ingress
Disposable native D1 with production Hub setup and actual Worker/DO RPC; global test jurisdiction resolves one DO, not deployment or residency proof
Native public-business groups require no run/execution/runner/provider operation; child domain fixtures use synthetic dormant ACL and immutable waiter/evidence setup
Authority is proved through the final database selection followed only by synchronous projection/secret attachment/serialization, not arbitrary later delivery time
Post-commit authority loss withholds a public reply and does not undo a valid previously committed command or independently committed revocation
Internal Hub/runner coordinates, observation clocks and original business transitions remain outside the new transport envelope

certification_corrections.detail: Native diagnostics exposed two composition ceilings: typed authority nested in a CHECK VALUES expression and an extra EXISTS around canonical artifact admission. Guard materialization is included in the implementation commit; e0610ea makes artifact owners supply the direct canonical SELECT. Current authority predicates, staged SELECT shape, one-use semantics and final projection are preserved. The initial failed clean certificate is excluded from passing acceptance.

The next clean attempt invoked a modern authority-wrapped task command on the intentional schema0028 pre0030 fixture. Native D1 reported the absent task_privacy table and the command rolled back. A named pre-authority SQL seed rejects current schema and retains exact before/after historical task projection assertions. Only the test harness changed; no production schema fallback, authority relaxation or clock change was added. The second failed certificate is excluded; the fresh repaired pipeline supplies every passing count.

excluded_preliminary_probes: Preliminary draft or invalid-fixture runs are not counted; only the finalized initial 14-work/8-child/16-mounted OLD suites supply the old-source totals
The two failed clean certificates are diagnostic/correction provenance, not passed C11/X03/full-verification evidence
Earlier focused, native and notification-only passes do not substitute for the completed unchanged clean-checkout pipeline
activation_barriers: GitHub key-collision policy and its internal helper bypass remain open
Execution-owned provider/runner/local-agent private delivery, destructive private retention and artifact-byte consumers remain excluded
Broader temporal boundaries after final selection or guard statements and runner/local lease expiry are not certified by this slice
Private creation, creator sharing, inherited private children, author-private checkpoints and C12 remain unavailable or planned
not_claimed: Complete C11 delivery/sharing acceptance or activation of any private control
Expanded 87-case or six-native-group replay on unfixed source
Native real OAuth/cookie/CLI ingress, live private R2/browser bytes, installed app, provider execution, persistent pilot, deployment or external CI
Rollback of valid committed commands whose outward result is withheld after an independent authority change
Fresh W03 visual acceptance, publication, canonical project knowledge, skills, vault, reminders or contribution views
redaction: Bounded counts and synthetic outcomes only; raw logs, credentials, private content and local paths are not committed
